steps.title: Confirm the basic facts on the official DPWH page
sub: Budget, location, status, dates and bidders match this page.

steps.title: Open the bid documents
sub: Look for the quantities, a Bill of Quantities and technical specifications.

steps.title: Read Claude's check and confirm its points against the sources
Verify the risk: Political economy and power concentration
sub: Read the source for any company–official link. Political-family context is background only: a family name is never evidence.

If an AMO name matches an official: confirm it is the same person (middle name, age, address, SEC filings) before relying on it. Search the surname on Pulitiklan (pulitiklan.com) and PCIJ's political dynasties database (pcij.org/political-dynasties).
Check the AMO and owners in the firm's SEC filings; the PCAB list names only the AMO.

steps.title: Check site and field evidence
sub: Check that the road and the stated length exist: compare the stations in the title with satellite imagery (Google Earth / OpenStreetMap), and look for an earlier contract on the same stretch.

steps.title: Write down what you found and keep the documents you relied on
sub: Screenshots, Bill of Quantities pages, photos or letters: attach them with your decision.
